mapper.select: SELECT id, secret_ciphertext, last_used_step FROM identity_authenticator WHERE identity_id = #{identityId} AND NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_authenticator (id, identity_id, secret_ciphertext, last_used_step, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{identityId}, #{secretCiphertext}, #{lastUsedStep}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE identity_authenticator SET last_used_step = #{step}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE id = #{id} AND last_used_step < #{step} AND NOT deleted
UPDATE identity_authenticator SET deleted = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE identity_id = #{identityId} AND NOT deleted
